== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Gold 5]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Icons row: the printed card has no [[Nav Computer]] icon (Limited face Premiere-L-gold5-decipher-archive.gif; also the Unlimited and Japanese faces). The 2017 slip adds it, a red square with an astromech dome at the right of the game-text box, and the 2018 E card and 2023 D-E1 card keep it. Only the icons at the game-text box are compared; the Scomp Link icon is at its left on every image.

Reprints: [[Gold 5 (Unlimited)]] (1996) prints the words of the Original column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.
